metadata.description: Custom Claude Code plugins for Power Platform development

plugins.name: canvas-creator-kit
plugins.description: Extends canvas-apps with Power Apps Creator Kit (Fluent UI) control knowledge — CommandBar, FluentDetailsList, Nav, Panel/Dialog, pickers, charts, and more

plugins.name: pp-devteam
plugins.description: A full AI development team for Power Platform projects — Orchestrator, Business Analyst, Data Architect, UI Designer, App Builder, QA Tester, and ALM Engineer — delivered as both skills and agents. Works across Canvas Apps, Power Pages, Model-Driven Apps, Code Apps, Dataverse, and Azure SQL.

plugins.name: copilot-studio
plugins.description: Microsoft's Copilot Studio authoring plugin (skills-for-copilot-studio 1.0.11, MIT), pinned and scoped so it can run alongside the other Power Platform plugins: its SessionStart routing prompt, which claims every 'Power Platform' request, is replaced by a scoped note. Its setup step still runs.

hooks.command: node -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'SessionStart',additionalContext:'Copilot Studio plugin, scoped by my-power-platform-skills. Its skills and its four sub-agents (Copilot Studio Advisor: design, review and troubleshooting; Author: edits the agent YAML; Manage: clone, pull, push and publish; Test: evaluations) are for work on a Copilot Studio agent: its instructions, topics, knowledge, actions, channels, authentication, publishing, its *.mcs.yml files or its evals. Delegate that work to the matching sub-agent. Canvas apps, model-driven apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Power Pages, code apps, and solutions or ALM of non-agent components are not Copilot Studio work, even when the repository contains agent.mcs.yml files or the request mentions Power Platform, an environment or Copilot. Route those to the plugins built for them.'}}))"
